g.text: Composition control across all 66 encoder pairs
CKA: 981 rows · CCA: 690 train / 291 test · diagonal = unchanged metric
Marker edge = first modality; fill = second. DNA blue · RNA green · protein orange. Retrieval follows registry order.
Residualization fits all rows before retrieval evaluation. These panels use one captured result state; see the source manifest.
